race.comment: SEQUEL (8) led and dominated in a similar race to this here three starts back. Has subsequently raced well in town but found that level beyond her. Should bounce straight to the front and back in her right race will prove very tough to catch. KILONOVA (5) scored over this distance at the Sunshine Coast two back then began poorly and didn't recover last time over the same track and trip. Capable mare who can test this field if she gets it right. BARRELLING (1) is back after a 23-week spell. Yet to fill a placing in three first-up runs but his form last prep in better races than this puts him right in contention. STRAIGHT BLAST (6) raced near the pace then proved far too good when resuming recently over this distance at Dalby. Lightly raced four-year-old who can hold that form and play a key role again. CHICAGO KING (3) doesn't win out of turn but has 15 top three finishes from 23 starts. Freshened up and not out of the contest.
